purpose: Test whether one shared lightweight spatial token mixer closes the remaining patch-interaction gap of the best horizon-weighted recurrent action-conditioned predictor.

research_question.primary: At identical data, query slates, teacher targets, seeds, schedule, loss, and 1500-update budget, does adding one shared pre-norm token-mixing attention block improve held-out planner-candidate ranking over the read-only horizon-weighted recurrent predictor?
research_question.mechanism: The current recurrent student summarizes projected visual patches by an independent mean. The frozen teacher can mix visual tokens before producing the next native latent. A single shared self-attention residual tests this spatial/token interaction hypothesis without adding per-horizon capacity or changing action conditioning.
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; 300 candidates inside a block are nested measurements, not independent replicates
research_question.primary_comparison: spatial-mixer treatment minus read-only horizon-weighted recurrent baseline at step 1500

entry_evidence.baseline_result: Horizon weighting was stable and slightly positive, but its ranking-effect gate failed; recurrent snapshots plateaued by step1000-1500.
entry_evidence.remaining_gap: The recurrent cell uses projected visual-token mean pooling and has no token-to-token interaction. This experiment isolates that structural gap.
entry_evidence.authorization: Use one shared token-mixer architecture cell; do not alter recurrent feedback, horizon weights, data, schedule, seeds, held-out protocol, or thresholds.

scope.observation_encoder_scope: out of scope; use cached native observation latents

baseline.architecture: RecurrentNativeLatentTransitionStudent, h256, shared residual transition, linear horizon weights
baseline.initialization_pairing: Use initialization seed 99 and the same initialization procedure; the historical baseline remains read-only and is not rerun or loaded.

treatment.name: spatial_mixer_recurrent
treatment.architecture: The horizon-weighted recurrent student plus one shared 4-head pre-norm MultiheadAttention residual over projected visual patch tokens; the same mixer, transition, and output heads are reused at k=0..4.

token_mixer.compact_vector_behavior: A one-token input is a degenerate identity-like mixer; compact-vector and LeWM transfer remain unverified mechanism hypotheses.

inputs.initial_visual: cached native context[visual][:,-1] with shape [B, patches, 384]
inputs.current_action: one normalized packed action token a_k with shape [B, 10]
inputs.history: only the current predicted native visual/proprio state; no teacher-forced future latent

cell_equations.pre_norm_attention: m_k = v_k + MHA(LN(v_k), LN(v_k), LN(v_k)), with one shared 4-head module
cell_equations.feedback: Predicted visual_{k+1} and proprio_{k+1}, without detach, are fed to k+1 during training and evaluation.

loss.reduction: For each horizon h compute 0.5 * (visual MSE + proprio MSE); total loss = (1/5) * sum_h w_h * mse_h.
loss.teacher_targets: detached dense future native visual/proprio latents from the frozen official teacher

forbidden: teacher or source predictor module inside the student
second attention layer or FFN subblock

context_schedule.generation: CPU permutation of 0..255 every 32 updates; consume eight consecutive ordinals

teacher_targets.target: detached dense future native visual/proprio latents for the exact four-query slate rows

seeds.cpu_generator_policy: Generate schedules, slates, held-out candidates, and timing candidates with explicit CPU generators before GPU transfer.

ranking.candidate_bank: reuse the exact held-out candidate bank and order from the recurrent/query-slate freeze

logged_action_fidelity.action: each held-out context's logged action prefix
logged_action_fidelity.comparison: spatial-mixer treatment / read-only horizon-weighted recurrent baseline

causality.procedure: For unchanged prefix lengths 1,2,3,4, change only later action tokens and compare outputs through the unchanged prefix.

latency.boundary: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through the predictor
latency.reduction: 1 - median(spatial-mixer student ms) / median(frozen teacher ms)
latency.baseline_ratio: Report treatment ms / read-only horizon-weighted recurrent ms as an engineering diagnostic only

heldout_evaluation.telemetry: During GPU execution append utilization and VRAM samples every 30 seconds to the job log.

architecture_effect.comparison: spatial-mixer treatment step1500 - read-only horizon-weighted recurrent baseline step1500

logged_mse_noninferiority.comparison: spatial-mixer treatment / read-only horizon-weighted recurrent baseline on held-out logged-action teacher-relative MSE

decision_levels.integrity: PASS iff all integrity fields pass.
decision_levels.convergence: PASS iff the treatment last10/first loss ratio is at most 0.8 and training is finite.
decision_levels.architecture_effect: PASS iff integrity, convergence, and all four architecture_effect thresholds pass.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff integrity, convergence, treatment absolute fidelity, logged MSE non-inferiority, causality, and predictor-only latency pass. This is independent of relative architecture effect.
decision_levels.spatial_mixer_supported_replacement: GO iff architecture_effect PASS and full_replacement GO.
decision_levels.invalidity: If the read-only baseline, shared banks, held-out pairing, integrity, convergence, or causality contract is invalid, report NO-GO and do not interpret ranking deltas.
decision_levels.no_retuning: Do not change mixer structure, hidden size, horizon weights, seeds, schedule, loss scale, steps, snapshots, or thresholds after observing results; do not select step1000 post hoc.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_architecture_effect_pass: 在冻结的 DINO-WM PushT predictor-level contract 下，指定的一个 shared 4-head pre-norm visual-token mixer 相比 read-only horizon-weighted recurrent predictor，在 held-out action-candidate ranking 上达到预先指定的 paired improvement。
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_replacement_go: Spatial-mixer recurrent student 在本协议的 absolute fidelity、MSE non-inferiority、causality 和 predictor-only latency 边界内可作为 predictor candidate。
claim_boundary.parameter_latency_sentence: 参数量和 predictor-only latency 只能作为工程 tradeoff 报告；attention 增加的成本与 ranking 变化应分别测量，不能仅由参数量推断收益。
claim_boundary.mechanism_boundary: 本实验只验证 patch-token interaction 在 DINO-WM PushT predictor 上的一个 architecture cell；compact-vector latent、LeWM、Fast-LeWM 和其他 JEPA-style WM 仅是待验证的机制假设。
forbidden: encode_obs speedup or observation encoder claim
full planner or closed-loop task success
claim that attention proves token mixing is the sole causal mechanism
claim that a one-token compact-vector case has been empirically validated

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as the primary result artifact.
